corrections.text: The summary and the "The Fix" section describe Zoox's remedy as an "over-the-air" software update and attribute that characterization to TechCrunch. None of the four cited sources use the phrase "over-the-air" or specify the update's delivery method. TechCrunch states only that Zoox "shipped to its fleet of 105 vehicles a software update"; Gizmodo says the company "released a software update to all affected vehicles"; Engadget says Zoox is "rolling out" the update; and Futurism describes the fix as being "in the form of a software update." The recall and the software-update fix are accurate and fully sourced; only the "over-the-air" delivery descriptor is unsupported by the cited reporting.
